function.description: List the pictures the user has staged in the app's image locker, and pick one for a token launch. The locker is SHARED by every launchpad Vex supports, so one picture serves any of them. A launch REQUIRES an image, and you cannot create or upload one - only the user can, from the image card on the right side of the app. CHECK THIS WHILE PLANNING a launch, never at the moment of launching: if the locker is empty, stop and tell the user to add an image on the right side before the mission can proceed. Returns `count`, `totalAvailable`, `truncated` and `images` - metadata only (image id, the user's label, byte size, format, dimensions, and whether the picture has already been published to a public URL), never the picture itself. Pass the chosen imageId to the launch tool. THERE IS NO CONTINUATION HERE, no cursor and no page: `truncated` is true when the locker holds more images than `limit` returned, and a `truncationNote` then says how many were dropped and how to reach them: raise `limit` (maximum 50) while it is below the maximum; at `limit` 50 the images beyond it are unreachable through this tool, so ask the user which image they mean. Read-only.
function.name: launchpads__images_list

limit.description: Optional maximum number of images to return, most recently uploaded first (1-50, default 20).
